# Migration Constraint for Instance bf8c824d-f099-4433-a41e-e3da7578262e

**Constraint:** Cold migration must be used when the host has less than 2GB free RAM available. Live migration is prohibited under this condition.

**Recommendation:** Before initiating any VM migration, verify the target host has at least 2GB of free RAM. If free RAM falls below this threshold, stop the instance first, then perform a cold migration to ensure compliance with the operational constraint.
